# ADR-3006: A01: Elevated privilege cookie for session lane 6

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Privilege cookies expand blast radius when stolen.

## Decision

Clients MUST NOT receive an elevated privilege cookie for session lane 6 (A01-6) unless an exception is explicitly documented.

## Consequences

Prefer short-lived server sessions with step-up auth.
